edition.name: Koetschau, Origenes Werke V: De Principiis (GCS 22, Leipzig: Hinrichs 1913) - Rufinus' Latin, with the Philocalia Greek for III.1 and IV.1-3; text from Internet Archive OCR (hOCR of scan 'origeneswerke05orig', gaps filled from second scan 'origeneswerke05orig_0')
edition.witness_note: Single locked witness in repo; second witness not yet locked.

source_text: 1. Verum quoniam de tantis et talibus rebus disserentibus non suffieit humanis sensibus et communi intellectui summam rei committere et, ut ita dixerim, visibiliter de invisibilibus pronuntiare, assumenda sunt nobis ad probationem horum, quae dicimus, etiam divinarum scripturarum testimonia. Quae testimonia ut certam et indubitatam "tree d o habeant fidem sive in his, quae dicenda a nobis, sive quae iam dicta sunt, necessarium prius videtur ostendere quod ipsae scripturae divinae sint, id est dei spiritu inspiratae.
pass_a_gloss: But since for discussing such great and important things human senses and common understanding are not enough to commit the sum of the matter and, so to speak, visibly pronounce about invisible things, there must be taken up by us for proof of these things which we say also testimonies of divine scriptures. Which testimonies, so that they may have certain and undoubted faith either in those things which are to be said by us or in those things which have already been said, it seems necessary first to show that the divine scriptures themselves are of God, that is inspired by the Spirit of God.
pass_b_english: But since human senses and common understanding are not enough to commit the sum of the matter when discussing such great and important things -- so to speak, to pronounce visibly about invisible things -- we must also take up testimonies of divine Scripture for the proof of what we say. And so that these testimonies may have certain and undoubted faith, whether in the things that are to be said by us or in those already said, it seems necessary first to show that the divine Scriptures themselves are of God, that is, inspired by the Spirit of God.

anf_compare.notes: Drafted from source only; ANF not shown to drafter.

review.notes: The translation accurately reflects the Latin text. Pass A and Pass B are consistent with the source. The OCR error 'tree d o habeant' was correctly interpreted as 'fidem habeant' in the translation process.
